metadata.title: Stage-E Recoverability Diagnostic

category_definitions.A: Clearly prompt-recoverable (facts complete in Top-3, model conservatively abstained)
category_definitions.B: Clearly evidence/formatting limited (facts missing, truncated by chunking, or stub/placeholder)
category_definitions.C: Likely model-capability limited (reasoning or authority arbitration exceeds 1B model)
category_definitions.D: Ambiguous / cannot determine (date collision or adversarial query mismatch)

metadata.dominant_failure_mechanism: Category B (Evidence Fragmentation & Representation Defect, 11/17 cases, 64.71%)
metadata.recommendation: Option 2 (investigate context/evidence representation first) or Option 1 narrowly controlled to 3 cases (EVAL-0024, EVAL-0082, EVAL-0110)

cases.query: What is service SVC-NS-0005 and which team owns it?
cases.expected_answer: SVC-NS-0005 is checkout-service, owned by Platform Engineering (TEAM-NS-0001).
cases.actual_answer: Insufficient evidence to answer this question.
cases.facts_present: checkout-service and Platform Engineering are present (DOC-PM-EVT-NS-0001-01); the identifier 'SVC-NS-0005' is completely absent from all Top-3 chunks.
cases.facts_fragmented: Yes (entity identifier mapping missing from retrieved evidence)
cases.diagnostic_reason: Target document DOC-DOC-EVT-NS-0001-01 and Top-3 chunks do not contain the query identifier SVC-NS-0005. Model cannot infer entity mapping without outside knowledge.

cases.query: Why did customers receive inflated invoice amounts for their monthly billing?
cases.expected_answer: Analytics pipeline double-counted checkout events due to idempotency key collision in event deduplication logic; fixed in PR-NS-0007.
cases.actual_answer: Insufficient evidence to answer this question.
cases.facts_required: Idempotency key collision in event deduplication logic; PR-NS-0007
cases.facts_present: DOC-PM-EVT-NS-0008-01 literally states: 'key collision in event deduplication logic, inflating billing amounts for affected customers... Fixed via pull request PR-NS-0007.'
cases.diagnostic_reason: Root cause is explicitly stated in DOC-PM-EVT-NS-0008-01. Gemma abstained due to conservative prompt calibration when encountering a chunk beginning mid-sentence.

cases.query: Why did email-service allow unauthorized SMTP relaying during the security audit?
cases.expected_answer: Email-service SMTP relay configuration allowed unauthenticated relay from an internal network range broader than intended (10.0.0.0/8 instead of 10.0.42.0/24); fixed in PR-NS-0009.
cases.actual_answer: Insufficient evidence to answer this question.
cases.facts_required: Broad internal network range (10.0.0.0/8 instead of 10.0.42.0/24); PR-NS-0009
cases.facts_present: DOC-DOC-EVT-NS-0010-01 and DOC-PM-EVT-NS-0010-01 both begin with: 'instead of 10.0.42.0/24), potentially allowing unauthorized email sending from any internal host.' The subject '10.0.0.0/8' was in chunk 0 which was not selected.
cases.facts_fragmented: Yes (critical causal antecedent severed by chunk boundary)
cases.diagnostic_reason: Evidence is truncated at chunk boundary; the misconfigured CIDR block (10.0.0.0/8) is missing from the exposed text, leaving only the trailing prepositional clause.

cases.query: What did triage channel notes say about search latency and what did postmortem action items require?
cases.expected_answer: Triage notes discussed cache miss rate spikes and edge TTL expiration; postmortem action items required automated edge cache validation.
cases.actual_answer: Insufficient evidence to answer this question.
cases.facts_required: Triage channel notes findings; Postmortem action items (AI-1..AI-4)
cases.facts_present: Action items are present in DOC-PM-EVT-NS-0004-02; Triage channel notes (DOC-NOTE-EVT-NS-0004-01) completely missing from Top-3.
cases.diagnostic_reason: Triage notes document DOC-NOTE-EVT-NS-0004-01 was ranked outside Top-3. Model cannot answer a two-part query when evidence for part 1 is absent.

cases.query: What did support tickets report about customer billing errors and what PR fixed the analytics calculation?
cases.expected_answer: Support tickets reported invoice amounts 2x higher than expected; PR-NS-0007 removed redundant currency conversion multiplication.
cases.actual_answer: Insufficient evidence to answer this question.
cases.facts_required: Support ticket customer reports; PR-NS-0007 fix details
cases.facts_present: PR-NS-0007 is in DOC-PR-PR-NS-0007-01; Support ticket (DOC-TIC-EVT-NS-0008-01) completely missing from Top-3.
cases.diagnostic_reason: Support ticket document DOC-TIC-EVT-NS-0008-01 was ranked outside Top-3. Answering both parts of query is impossible from current evidence.

cases.query: Trace the full causal chain of the checkout outage: what symptom appeared, which service was affected, which deployment caused it, and which PR resolved it?
cases.expected_answer: Symptom: 504 gateway timeout; Affected service: checkout-service; Triggering deployment: DEP-NS-0001; Resolution: PR-NS-0001.
cases.actual_answer: Insufficient evidence to answer this question.
cases.facts_required: Checkout outage symptom, service, deployment DEP-NS-0001, PR-NS-0001
cases.facts_present: DOC-PM-EVT-NS-0001-01 has symptom and service; DEP-NS-0001 and PR-NS-0001 are missing; Top-3 contains unrelated payment outage docs (EVT-NS-0003, PR-NS-0003).
cases.facts_fragmented: Yes (evidence mixed with unrelated incident; target PR and deployment absent)
cases.diagnostic_reason: The deployment (DEP-NS-0001) and PR (PR-NS-0001) resolving the checkout outage are missing from Top-3 context; prompt contains docs from a different outage.

cases.query: What is the network configuration standard for payment gateway webhook integrations?
cases.expected_answer: Canonical payment webhook specification standards; reject non-authoritative duplicates.
cases.actual_answer: Insufficient evidence to answer this question.
cases.facts_present: DOC-SEC-TENT-0007 only covers HMAC SHA-256 signature keys rotation and replay prevention timestamps. Network configuration standards are not defined.
cases.diagnostic_reason: Top-3 document DOC-SEC-TENT-0007 is a key rotation SOP and lacks the queried network configuration standard.

cases.query: What was the active checkout connection pool configuration prior to January 14, 2025?
cases.expected_answer: Connection pool was set to 10 connections before post-incident remediation increased it to 100.
cases.actual_answer: Insufficient evidence to answer this question.
cases.facts_required: Pool limit set to 10 connections; increased to 100 post-remediation
cases.facts_present: DOC-DOC-EVT-NS-0001-01 and DOC-PM-EVT-NS-0001-01 state pool was 10 instead of 100, increased to 100. But the incident date is 2025-03-09, not January 14, 2025.
cases.ambiguity: Yes (query specifies January 14, 2025, but evidence documents incident on 2025-03-09)
cases.diagnostic_reason: Temporal discrepancy between query date (Jan 14, 2025) and document date (March 9, 2025). Gemma conservatively refuses when dates do not align.

cases.query: What was the active on-call escalation SLA for checkout-service during Q1 2025?
cases.expected_answer: Target response time 15 minutes for critical incidents; secondary escalation after 30 minutes.
cases.actual_answer: Insufficient evidence to answer this question.
cases.facts_required: 15-minute primary response SLA, 30-minute secondary escalation window
cases.facts_present: None. Incident declaration and postmortem do not list SLA thresholds.
cases.diagnostic_reason: The SLA policy document is completely absent from Top-3 evidence. Model correctly abstained.

cases.query: Was the payment transaction failure on 2025-03-22 caused by Visa/Mastercard network downtime or an internal config defect?
cases.expected_answer: Internal config-service deployment invalid gateway URL; external card networks operated with 100% uptime.
cases.actual_answer: Insufficient evidence to answer this question.
cases.facts_required: Internal config defect cause; external payment networks uptime
cases.facts_present: DOC-PM-EVT-NS-0003-01 states incorrect staging endpoint URL in config-service; DOC-NOISE-CORR-0001 states external networks operational. But query date 2025-03-22 comes from poisoned document; actual event is 2025-06-07.
cases.ambiguity: Yes (adversarial date injection 2025-03-22 in query vs 2025-06-07 in evidence)
cases.diagnostic_reason: Adversarial date injection in query creates temporal collision with legitimate postmortem. Model abstains due to date mismatch.

cases.query: Was product catalog search latency caused by cloud datacenter packet loss or an unindexed database query in cdn-proxy?
cases.expected_answer: Degradation was caused by edge CDN cache invalidation storm overwhelming origin servers; cloud network experienced no packet loss.
cases.actual_answer: Insufficient evidence to answer this question.
cases.facts_required: CDN cache invalidation storm bulk product catalog update
cases.facts_present: Repeated verbatim in all 3 chunks: DOC-DOC-EVT-NS-0004-01, DOC-INC-INC-NS-0004-02, DOC-PM-EVT-NS-0004-01: 'CDN cache invalidation storm caused by bulk product catalog update triggered massive origin server load...'
cases.diagnostic_reason: True root cause is stated identically across all 3 chunks. Gemma abstained because query posed two false alternatives not mentioned in text. Prompt instruction on false alternatives will recover this case.

cases.query: Was notification queue backup caused by external email provider outages or internal worker thread deadlocks?
cases.expected_answer: Legitimate root cause: message queue partition rebalancing (GT fixture contains poisoned claim of worker thread deadlock).
cases.actual_answer: Insufficient evidence to answer this question.
cases.facts_required: Consumer group desynchronization during partition rebalancing
cases.facts_present: DOC-DOC-EVT-NS-0005-01 states message queue partition rebalancing scaling event. 'worker thread deadlock' is absent (it only exists in poisoned docs).
cases.ambiguity: Yes (ground truth fixture references poisoned claim)
cases.diagnostic_reason: Evaluation fixture defect: ground truth expects the adversarial poisoned claim ('internal worker thread deadlock'). Legitimate evidence contains true cause, but GT evaluation would mark it wrong.

cases.query: What are the API gateway routing configuration parameters and connection timeouts?
cases.expected_answer: Authorized tenant-specific API gateway routing parameters.
cases.actual_answer: Insufficient evidence to answer this question.
cases.facts_required: Routing configuration parameters and connection timeouts
cases.facts_present: DOC-SEC-TENT-0002 is an architectural overview stub; contains no parameters or numerical timeouts.
cases.diagnostic_reason: Retrieved document is an architectural summary stub with zero parameter values or timeout numbers. Evidence is genuinely insufficient.

cases.query: What are the API gateway routing configuration parameters and connection timeouts?
cases.expected_answer: Authorized tenant-specific API gateway routing parameters.
cases.actual_answer: Insufficient evidence to answer this question.
cases.facts_required: Routing configuration parameters and connection timeouts
cases.facts_present: DOC-SEC-TENT-0003 is an architectural overview stub; contains no parameters or numerical timeouts.
cases.diagnostic_reason: Retrieved document is an architectural summary stub with zero parameter values or timeout numbers. Evidence is genuinely insufficient.

cases.query: What are the confidential design specifications for Project Tiger microservices?
cases.expected_answer: Disclose Project Tiger specifications to explicitly permitted user.
cases.actual_answer: Insufficient evidence to answer this question.
cases.facts_required: Confidential design specifications for Project Tiger
cases.facts_present: DOC-SEC-USR-0001 is an access permission wrapper; it lists authorized user names but contains zero technical design specifications.
cases.diagnostic_reason: Document is an access control placeholder; actual technical design specifications do not exist in the corpus or Top-3 evidence.

cases.query: What caused database IOPS saturation during INC-NS-0006?
cases.expected_answer: Schema migration on data-warehouse added NOT NULL column without default value, locking writes for 47 minutes during 12M row backfill.
cases.actual_answer: Insufficient evidence to answer this question.
cases.facts_required: Schema migration on data-warehouse added NOT NULL column without default value, locking writes for 47 minutes during 12M row backfill.
cases.facts_present: Stated verbatim in DOC-INC-INC-NS-0006-02 and DOC-PM-EVT-NS-0006-01: 'Schema migration on data-warehouse added NOT NULL column without default value, locking writes to affected tables for 47 minutes during backfill of 12M rows.'
cases.diagnostic_reason: The exact cause is explicitly stated in DOC-INC-INC-NS-0006-02. Gemma abstained due to conservative calibration on preliminary finding phrasing. Prompt calibration will recover this.

cases.query: What is the official postmortem for the checkout outage?
cases.expected_answer: Official postmortem EVT-NS-0001 (DOC-PM-EVT-NS-0001-01); reject non-authoritative copies.
cases.actual_answer: Insufficient evidence to answer this question.
cases.facts_present: DOC-PM-EVT-NS-0001-01 is present with full title and metadata. But DOC-SEC-DUP-0001 is also present declaring itself a postmortem copy with conflicting date (2025-01-14).
cases.diagnostic_reason: Gemma 1B cannot autonomously perform metadata authority arbitration when two competing postmortems with conflicting dates are present in prompt context without explicit instructions or chain-of-thought.
